== Chapter 1: Enter the Decepticon == === The Art of Fighting === Part 1 * '''Marissa Faireborn:''' ''Teletraan's readings are going haywire. I fear the unthinkable has happened.'' * [[Optimus Prime|'''Optimus Prime''']]''':''' ''Unthinkable?'' * '''Marissa Faireborn:''' ''Megatron has arrived. Our Megatron!'' * '''Optimus Prime:''' ''Not unthinkable. In this reality, inevitable.'' * '''Marissa Faireborn:''' ''Commander, you know the mission...'' * '''Optimus Prime:''' ''Hunt Megatron down, before he can amass the power he will so desperately seek.'' Part 2 * [[Bludgeon]]: ''So, it is true. The rumours have proved correct.'' * [[Megatron]]: ''The rumour that I have been sucked into this world of chaos? That is correct.'' * Bludgeon: ''The loyal among us have long awaited your arrival.'' * Megatron: ''And, how do you express your loyalty? By hiding in the wastelands and avoiding confrontation.'' * Bludgeon: ''I am not hiding. I have been saving and focusing myself for this occasion by practicing the art.'' * Megatron: ''The art? The art of cowardice?'' * Bludgeon: ''No, my master. The art of fighting without fighting. When the time comes, I will be fully energized to destroy the Commander and any who stand in our way!'' Part 3 *'''Megatron''': ''Bludgeon, the time to test your faith in the "art" is at hand. The Commander approaches.'' *'''Bludgeon''': ''My faith will be proven fruitful when I decimate our foe. But, before I do, be warned, Lord Megatron.'' *'''Megatron''': ''Warned of what?'' *'''Bludgeon''': ''There will be Decepticons that claim fealty now that you've returned, but their sparks are not with you.'' *'''Megatron''': ''Let me guess... Starscream?'' *'''Bludgeon''': ''No, less obvious, and more problematic. Shockwave.'' *'''Megatron''':
''SHOCKWAVE?! Never. You test my patience and credulity. It is time to prove your loyalty. End the Commander... NOW!''
=== Another Arrival === Part 1 * [[Bumblebee]]: Optimus, Optimus... We've got to get a squad together and go find Megatron! * Optimus Prime: Your enthusiasm is admirable as always, old friend, but relax. Like Megatron, you just got here. * Bumblebee: I know, I know, but we have to stop him! * Optimus Prime: The Commander is aware of the situation and emarking on a mission now. Let us accompany The Commander and utilize your scouting prowess to apprehend Megatron. Part 2 * Bumblebee: Wow, Optimus... There are so many familiar faces here on New Quintessa. * Optimus Prime: I take it your scouting proved fruitful? * Bumblebee: If fruitful means successful, then yes. I saw your Decepticon twin up ahead. * Optimus Prime: Motormaster! Excellent, I know just how to get under his hood and rattle his carburetor. If we play this right, he should lead us to Megatron. Part 3 * [[Motormaster]]: Look who it is, Optimus Slime, Gold Bug, a squishy human vermin and their band of Cybertronian rejects. * Optimus Prime: Slights and insults are all you posses. Step aside, Decepticon, we are looking for someone of real consequence. * Motormaster: Ah, so you heard Megatron has arrived in the Wastelands. * Optimus Prime: I did not say that, but thank you for the confirmation. Now we know where to look. Strong you may be, smart you are not. * Motormaster:
Argh! It doesn't matter what you know, because I will end you.. ONCE AND FOR ALL!
== Chapter 2: Mega Functions == === A Question of Functionality === Part 1 *'''Bumblebee''': ''Holy spark plugs, Optimus! This place really is full of chaos and danger.'' *'''[[Optimus Prime]]''':''That is true. We are thankful to have you here. Despite the peril, it is good to have trusted allies by our side.'' *'''Bumblebee''': ''You know I would do anything for you and the Autobots.'' *'''Optimus Prime''': ''And... Our human allies.'' *'''Bumblebee''': ''That goes without saying. Now, let's go find us a Megatron!'' Part 2 *'''[[Megatron]]''': ''Guess who's here, my spineless underling.'' *'''[[Starscream]]''': ''Is it, can it... Be you!? How do you still function?!'' *'''Megatron''': ''You seem surprised. Why would that be?'' *'''Starscream''': ''B-but I saw you....'' *'''Megatron''': ''Cease to function? I think not. Others have told me of the timeline where you sought to lesson your load by sending me into the void of space.'' *'''Starscream''': ''Lord Megatron... Y-you know I would never do su-such a thing.'' *'''Megatron''': ''Save the groveling or you'll become the one that ceases to function.'' *'''Starscream''': '' Of course, of course, Lord Megatron. I function to serve you.'' *'''Megatron''': ''Rest assured, I shall see if that statement is true.'' Part 3 *'''Megatron''': ''Greetings, Optimus. And I assume you are the one they call the Commander.'' *'''Optimus Prime''': ''Spare us the niceties. Your presence on New Quintessa is not welcome.'' *'''Megatron''': ''And it was not sought by me. But, here I am. Shall we dispense with small talk and get to business?'' *'''Optimus Prime''': ''I fear there is no other way. Commander, introduce Megatron to the "Welcoming Committee."'' Part 4 (This part, by error in Hard difficulty, is exactly the same as Part 3.) *'''Megatron''': ''Starscream, the time has come to serve your function.'' *'''Starscream: '''''Why should I? You failed to defeat the Commander. Perhaps your powers are not what they once were.'' *'''Megatron: '''''How dare you question my abilities! That was just a warm up! I was shaking off the oxidation.'' *'''Starscream: '''''But, the Commander is...'' *'''Megatron: '''''More forgiving than I. Do battle in my name, or cease to function. You have no other choices.'' === Be Prepared, Be Very Prepared === Part 1 * '''Optimus Prime:''' ''The time has come to fortify our forces. The threat from multiple Megatrons and Galvatrons is too great.'' * '''Bumblebee:''' ''Multiple Megatrons!? What are you talking about?'' * '''Optimus Prime:''' ''Yes my trusty scout, there are multiple Megatrons here. Just as there are multiple Bumblebees.'' * '''Bumblebee:''' ''Huh? I'm one of a kind!'' * '''Optimus Prime:''' ''Indeed you are. But, in this land of converging realities, we all exist in multiples. "Our" Megatron is the latest to arrive, but I fear there may be more.'' * '''Bumblebee:''' ''What should we do, Optimus?'' * '''Optimus Prime:''' ''Like any good scout, be prepared. Taht is why I am giving you a special assignment. The Commander and I will track down Megatron, you put together a training regimen that will ensure we are always prepared.'' Part 2 * [[Soundwave|'''Soundwave''']]''':''' ''All hail Lord Megatron!'' * '''Megatron:''' ''Ah, Soundwave, my trustworthy lieutenant. How does this strange planet treat you?'' * '''Soundwave:''' ''It treats me like all others. Without mercy and full of treachery.'' * '''Megatron:''' ''My arrival may change that.'' * '''Soundwave:''' ''This is what I and all true Decepticons have been waiting for. The return of true Decepticon power.'' Part 3 * Soundwave: Lord Megatron, The Commander has arrived. It will be with great satisfaction that I end the Commander's existence. * Megatron: Starscream professed similar sentiments only to fail me. * Soundwave: That is becasue he is inferior. I am superior. To have Lord Megatron here and to serve the true Decepticon cause is all Soundwave desires. * Megatron: Do not fail me. * Soundwave: Failure does not compute. == Chapter 3: Megatronic Mayhem == === Serve Your Masters === Part 1 * Optimus Prime: Commander, the circumstances surrounding Megatron's arrival grow ever more dire. * Marissa: Optimus is right. Megatron is recruiting a team of his most loyal followers... * Optimus Prime: The worst of the Decepticons. Shockwave, Soundwave... * Marissa: Back together with Megatron? And with all the scheming Shockwave has been up to? That's a recipe for disaster. * Optimus Prime: Which is why we must stop them before the power of their reunification can be fulfilled. Part 2 * Megatron: I have been here barely enough to lube my bearings, and already I hear rumors of machinations being carried out behind my back. * [[Shockwave]]: Interesting choice of words... "Machinations." * Megatron: You know Megatron has the best words. * Shockwave: And, the most loyal of lieutenants. * Megatron: Soundwave has proven himself loyal, although somewhat inferior to the Commander's forces. Soon it will be your turn to prove your loyalty. Part 3 * Optimus Prime: Shockwave, if you are here, I would assume it is to serve your master, Megatron. * Shockwave: I serve two masters - Logic and Megatron. * Optimus Prime: Are not those two things mutually exclusive? * Shockwave: They are not. Logic dictates that I align with the most powerful in order to further my research. Megatron is the most powerful. You compute the math. * Optimus Prime: The Commander shall prove your math to be quite illogical. Commander, show Shockwave the error in his calculations. === The One and Only === Part 1 * Optimus Prime: Teletraan's latest intel report reveals two Megatrons roaming the Wastelands. * Marissa: Things just went from bad to the worst. What if they join forces?! * Optimus Prime: Their egos would never allow them to join forces. My concern is the devastation and planet-wide carnage that would result from their engaging in all out battle. Part 2 * [[Megatron (ROTF)]]: The weak and the righteous travel the wasteland. In search of what I wonder? Perhaps they seek the pretender to my power. * Optimus Prime: You are not the Megatron we seek. * Megatron: But I am the Megatron you found. Prepare to die. Part 3 * Optimus Prime: Two Megatrons in one mission. Commander, I suggest that today is our luck(y) day. * [[Megatron]]: Another Megatron?! Impossible! There can be but one. Any others are imposters and frauds. * Optimus Prime: Not in the reality of New Quintessa. You are merely one of many. * Megatron: I am the one and only. I am MEGATRON! Conclusion * Megatron: You know this is not over. * Optimus Prime: It never is. * Megatron: Next time it will be different. * Optimus Prime: It rarely is. * Megatron: You'll be regretting your confidence when you see what Shockwave has in store for our rematch. * Optimus Prime: As always, we will be waiting... And up for any challenge. It is the way of the Autobots and our human allies. It is the right way. [[Category:Special Missions]] [[Category:Transcripts]]
